question: Which of the following pairs of Indian rivers is west flowing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada and Tapi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narmada and Tap**i

 
 
• These **are the two major west-flowing rivers in Peninsular India**.
 
• The Narmada **originates in the Maikala range** near Amarkantak and flows through the rift valley between the Satpura and Vindhyan ranges.
 
• It** meets the Arabian Sea south of Bharuch**, forming a 27 km long estuary.
 
• The Narmada is **also known as the Rewa River.**
 
• **Other west-flowing rivers in India include Sabarmati, Mahi, Bharathapuzha, and Periyar**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9717625a3542d8ab9d2d6fe9bedb7d8c08a95ae18261f2ff6def12820eec8717.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahanadi**

 
 
• **​​**This **river originates in Chhattisgarh** and flows through Odisha, as well as parts of Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra.
 
• It's **also known as the Hirakund Dam**.
 
 
 
• **Godavar**i
 
 
• This **river originates in Trimbakeshwar, Maharashtra,** 
 
• It flows through Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha.
 
• It's the **second-longest river in India **
 
• It **also known as Dakshin Ganga or Vridha Ganga.**
 
 
 
• **Krishna**
 
 
• This **river originates near Mahabaleshwar in the Western Ghats** and
 
• It **flows through Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It's the **third-longest river in India.**
 
 
 
• **Kaveri**
 
 
• This river **originates in Talakaveri, Karnataka, and flows through Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It's the **third-largest river in Southern India ** 
 
• It considered **one of the seven holy rivers of India. **
